answer: Pool the risk, not the head count. Ten identities form one insurance pool, each locking 60 POA for 4 epochs. A newcomer waits one epoch on a ledge while nine strangers vet it; three must stake 10 POA on it to join. Each epoch the pool answers one cipher challenge, every member signing with its own key within 30 minutes. One convicted fake costs every member 15 POA, an ember burning the whole pool. Ten fakes must choose: pack one pool and risk 150 POA on one conviction, or pass ninety vetting checks across ten honest pools. The chain records pools, stakes, signatures, and slashes.
